docs.title: finmetry
docs.text: A research-first quantitative trading framework for systematic experimentation, backtesting, and reproducible strategy development.

docs.title: Design principles
docs.text:
• Research-first, not trading-first
  • Explicit assumptions
  • No hidden state
  • Reproducible experiments

docs.title: Who this is for
docs.text:
• Quant researchers
  • Systematic traders
  • ML researchers working with financial data

docs.title: What finmetry is NOT
docs.text:
• Not a signal-selling tool
  • Not a plug-and-play trading bot

docs.title: API Reference
docs.text:
This section documents the public Python API of finmetry.

Only stable, research-facing interfaces are included. Internal helpers are intentionally undocumented.
